artifacts.name: celsius_to_fahrenheit
artifacts.description: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
artifacts.usage_description: Use this when you need to convert a numeric temperature in Celsius to Fahrenheit.

artifact_versions.content:
local function celsius_to_fahrenheit(c: number): number
    -- Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit using the exact formula
    return c * 9 / 5 + 32
end
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
local f = celsius_to_fahrenheit(input.celsius)
return { fahrenheit = f }
end

generation_jobs.goal: Generate a reusable Luau function: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.

Generate a reusable Luau function: List customers of a segment and send the message 'Hi <name>, we miss you!' to every customer with last_seen_days >= inactive_days (user = customer id). Return notified (ids whose send succeeded, in list order), failed (ids whose send failed) and count (= number notified). If listing fails, return {error, message} from the tool. tools.message.send may be called at most 10 times per execution.

generation_attempts.content:
local function celsius_to_fahrenheit(c: number): number
    -- Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit using the exact formula
    return c * 9 / 5 + 32
end
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
local f = celsius_to_fahrenheit(input.celsius)
return { fahrenheit = f }
end

local function send_message(userId: string, name: string): { ok: boolean, id: string?, error: string?, message: string? }
	local text = "Hi " .. name .. ", we miss you!"
	local r = tools.message.send({ user = userId, text = text })
	if r.error then
		return { ok = false, error = r.error, message = r.message }
	end
	return { ok = true, id = r.message_id }
end
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
if listed.error then
	return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
end

local notified = {}
local failed = {}
local sent_count = 0
local eligible_count = 0

for _, customer in listed.customers do
	if customer.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
		eligible_count += 1
		if sent_count >= 10 then
			return { error = "limit_exceeded", message = "message.send may be called at most 10 times per execution" }
		end

		local result = send_message(customer.id, customer.name)
		if result.ok then
			table.insert(notified, customer.id)
			sent_count += 1
		else
			table.insert(failed, customer.id)
		end
	end
end

return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
